page_title: Νεόδμητη Κατοικία στα Βριλήσσια | Ευγειος Goodland ΕΠΕ
heading: ΟΛΥΜΠΟΥ 23, ΒΡΙΛΗΣΣΙΑ
description_el: Ανέγερση δύο τριώροφων Οικοδομών με Υπόγειο.
description_en: Construction of two three-story buildings with a basement.

lots.text_el: Αποτελείται από 3 υπνοδωμάτια, κουζίνα, σαλόνι, καθιστικό, τραπεζαρία, 2 μπάνια & υπόγειο Play Room. Διαθέτει θέση πάρκινγκ & αποθήκη στο υπόγειο, ξυλινα πατώματα, θερμομονωτικά κουφώματα, σίτες, ενεργειακούς υαλοπίνακες, κέλυφος εξωτερικής θερμομόνωσης, παροχή για φορτιστή ηλεκτρικού οχήματος. Προβλέπεται τοποθέτηση και σύνδεση ηλιακού θερμοσίφωνα. Η θέρμανση πραγματοποιείται μέσω ενδοδαπέδιου συστήματος με αντλία θερμότητας και η ψύξη με fan coil units.
lots.text_en: It consists of 3 bedrooms, kitchen, living room, sitting room, dining room, 2 bathrooms & a basement Play Room. It has a parking space & a storage room in the basement, wooden floors, thermally insulated frames, screens, energy-efficient glazing, external thermal insulation shell, power supply for an electric vehicle charger. Installation and connection of a solar water heater is provided. Heating is provided through an underfloor system with a heat pump and cooling with a fan coil units.

notes: 16 lots (8 ground-floor 'GROUNDFLOOR n'/'ΙΣΟΓΕΙΟ n', 2 on 1st floor, 4 maisonettes 1st-2nd floor, 2 on 2nd floor). Unlike the reference page, some lots carry an explicit availability marker 'Διαθέσιμο' + 'available' (GROUNDFLOOR 4, GROUNDFLOOR 6, 1st FLOOR 91 m2) with no price: status=available, price=null. Lots with a price (440.000€, 544.000€, 675.000€, 555.000€) have no marker. Extra field 'status_text' keeps the exact marker/price text (lines joined by a space); marker spelling varies on the page ('(Not available)', '(not available)', and '(Νot available)' with a Greek capital Nu, as reported by the fetch tool). GROUNDFLOOR 2: English says 127 m2 but Greek says 'ΔΙΑΜΕΡΙΣΜΑ 128 Τ.Μ.' (m2 set to 127 from the English line). GROUNDFLOOR 4/5/6: the English text has a garden/swimming-pool sentence absent from the Greek text (verified). Some Greek 'μπάνιo' are written with a Latin 'o' (GROUNDFLOOR 2, 3, 7, 1st FLOOR 104 and 91), kept as reported. Typos 'threee', 'ξυλινα', '1 w.c. .' kept as on page. Basement images y1_/y5_/y7_/y8_ and ΟΛΥΜΠΟΥ-Β3 appear in the HTML after the lot's status marker but before the next lot; assigned to the lot by their filename numbering. Multiple spaces in headings ('1st - 2nd   FLOOR', '1ος - 2ος  ΟΡΟΦΟΣ' with a trailing zero-width char) and in the 3D heading were normalized to single spaces. Slideshow word 'Next' appears 16 times (once per lot). Header has 'top of page', 'MENU'; footer 'bottom of page'. Building images 1.jpg and 2.jpg are reused in the 3D renders gallery. Extraction method: WebFetch limits exact quotes to ~125 chars, so paragraphs were obtained as consecutive exact fragments and re-joined with single spaces; repeated common sentences were checked across several fetches.
